values.en: Equivalence R is a proposition about a fixed relation R. A Setoid on A instead packages a relation R together with a proof h : Equivalence R. We write Setoid.mk(A,R,h) for this package; its underlying relation is Setoid.r(A,S). The type A is an explicit retained implicit parameter in these SNL calls.
values.zh-CN: Equivalence R 是关于给定关系 R 的命题；Setoid A 则打包关系 R 及证明 h : Equivalence R。记 Setoid.mk(A,R,h) 为这份结构，Setoid.r(A,S) 为其底层关系。这些 SNL 调用显式保留隐式类型参数 A。
